scope: Stock operator-registered local native dependency policy and tool invocation boundary.

reviewObservations.ios: Verified vendored dependency bytes in a per-job copy. The CLI supplies job-local DerivedData and SourcePackages. Xcode receives per-job TMPDIR and CFFIXED_USER_HOME.
reviewObservations.androidMac: The worker verifies the common bare mirrors. File-only resolution and private SwiftPM scratch, cache, config and security paths are configured.
reviewObservations.androidLinuxPair25: Pinned common toolchain and mirror inputs mount read-only. The container has private tmpfs work and temp, and its operation has a distinct delivery bind.
reviewObservations.controls: Two private workspace paths on each platform, two Android driver invocations with inert tooling, and two Pair25 command layouts. Runner configurations reject a dependency_cache field.

scopeLimit: Actual Xcode cache writes, SwiftPM consumption, and Docker mount readback during ordinary jobs are pending. The two-tenant fixture used synthetic CLI outputs.
